# Claims ledger

Every statement that Vaultex's checked public documents make about the project has an entry here, with its status, its pinned evidence and the date by which it must be re-checked. A claim that stops being true is not deleted: it moves to [Withdrawn claims](#withdrawn-claims), with the date and the reason.

Checked documents: [README.md](README.md), [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md). Every claim-bearing line in them maps to a claim below; `python3 -I claims/claims.py check` enforces this, together with evidence pinning and expiry.

- **verified**: evidence is attached and pinned to a commit, a transaction or a CI run.
- **limitation**: a known weakness, stated publicly. Fixes are tracked by category in [SECURITY_STATUS.md](SECURITY_STATUS.md).
- **hypothesis**: not yet proven. It may appear only in plans and research, marked as a hypothesis.
- **withdrawn**: stated publicly in the past and now retracted. No document may repeat it.

Each claim is one file, `claims/<workstream>/<slug>.toml`, with the ID `<workstream>.<slug>`. The fields are defined in [claims/schema.toml](claims/schema.toml). Evidence links point at fixed commits, so they keep showing what was checked.

## Capability claims

### `01.architecture`

In the code, each MPC node holds one key share in its own encrypted key store, a gateway orchestrator coordinates the nodes over NATS, and the chain crates build and encode transactions. The gateway holds no key shares, but it does hold signing authority: see limitation (4) of the banner.

中文：在代码中，每个 MPC 节点在自己的加密密钥存储中持有一个密钥份额，网关协调器通过 NATS 协调各节点，链相关的 crate 负责构建和编码交易。网关不持有密钥份额，但持有签名权限：见警示中的限制 (4)。

- **Status:** verified · **kind:** capability · **owner:** WS-01
- **Observed:** 2026-10-11 · **expires:** 2027-01-09
- **Appears in:** [README.md](README.md), [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

Evidence:

- code [`services/mpc-node/src/main.rs`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/blob/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3/services/mpc-node/src/main.rs) (`EncryptedFileStore`) at [`26fd97460`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/commit/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3). Each node opens its own encrypted key store for its share
- code [`services/api-gateway/src/orchestrator.rs`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/blob/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3/services/api-gateway/src/orchestrator.rs) at [`26fd97460`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/commit/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3). The orchestrator keeps wallet metadata and talks to the nodes over NATS
- command `git grep -nE 'EncryptedFileStore|KeyStore' <commit> -- services/api-gateway/src` at [`26fd97460`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/commit/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3) → one match, an error-mapping arm in errors.rs; the gateway opens no key store

### `01.chain.aptos`

Aptos (APT, coins, fungible assets) on testnet: transaction bytes are byte-equal to @aptos-labs/ts-sdk reference vectors, and transactions signed with FROST Ed25519 were confirmed on the Aptos testnet at the time. The Aptos testnet has since been reset, so those transactions can no longer be retrieved. Staged.

### `01.chain.bitcoin`

Bitcoin testnet, P2WPKH (BTC): a transaction built by the encoder was confirmed on the Bitcoin testnet; no SDK reference vector exists for it. It was signed with a hand-rolled threshold-ECDSA engine, which is experimental (limitation 1). P2WPKH addresses shown for FROST-TR wallets may be unspendable (limitation 5). Staged.

中文：Bitcoin 测试网，P2WPKH（BTC）：由编码器构建的交易已在 Bitcoin 测试网上确认；该链没有 SDK 参考向量。交易由自行实现的门限 ECDSA 引擎签名，该引擎为实验性（限制 1）。为 FROST-TR 钱包显示的 P2WPKH 地址可能无法花费（限制 5）。状态：预备。

### `01.encoders.staged`

The chain transaction encoders work for six chains: TRON, Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, Sui and Aptos. Where an official SDK reference exists, nine reference-vector tests pin their output byte-for-byte to it, and the encoders have produced confirmed transactions on public testnets. They are staged: testnet only.

中文：链交易编码器适用于六条链：TRON、Ethereum、Bitcoin、Solana、Sui 和 Aptos。在有官方 SDK 参考实现的情况下，九个参考向量测试将其输出与之逐字节锁定；这些编码器已在公共测试网上产生经确认的交易。状态为预备：仅限测试网。

- **Status:** verified · **support:** staged · **kind:** capability · **owner:** WS-01

## Limitation claims

### `01.banner`

UNAUDITED PRE-ALPHA RESEARCH SOFTWARE · TESTNET ONLY · DO NOT USE WITH REAL FUNDS. Known critical limitations (by category): (1) affected scheme classes — the hand-rolled threshold-ECDSA engines are unsound, and Sr25519/BLS signing is not threshold; (2) transport confidentiality during key generation; (3) control-plane freshness; (4) unenforced signing policy — signers do not independently verify what they sign; (5) unsafe deposit addresses: addresses exported by pre-cut versions for unimplemented chains, and P2WPKH addresses shown for FROST-TR wallets, may be unspendable; do not send funds to them.

中文：未经审计的 Pre-Alpha 研究软件 · 仅限测试网 · 请勿用于真实资金。已知的严重限制（按类别）：(1) 受影响的签名方案类别 — 自行实现的门限 ECDSA 引擎不安全（unsound），且 Sr25519/BLS 签名并非门限签名；(2) 密钥生成期间的传输机密性；(3) 控制平面消息的新鲜性；(4) 签名策略未被强制执行 — 签名节点不会独立验证其所签署的内容；(5) 不安全的充值地址：代码裁剪（pre-cut）之前的版本为尚未实现的链导出的地址，以及为 FROST-TR 钱包显示的 P2WPKH 地址，可能无法花费；请勿向这些地址转入资金。

- **Status:** limitation · **kind:** limitation · **owner:** WS-01
- **Observed:** 2026-10-11 · **expires:** 2027-01-09
- **Appears in:** [README.md](README.md), [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

Evidence:

- document [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/blob/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3/docs/ROADMAP.md#m5-contain-cut-and-licence-phase-1) at [`26fd97460`](https://github.com/itoonx/vaultex-mpc-rust/commit/26fd974608adca177ebfcab239ed8aef3de8a6a3). ### `01.roadmap.proposed`

The roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md) and the task backlog (docs/TASKS.md) are proposals awaiting owner decisions. No single party ever holds a complete private key; the full private key is never assembled, not even during key generation.
